text:
anya: anyone else seeing a spike in scheduling latency + GPU evictions after the shrinkwrap rollout? noticed ~200 reschedules in the last 10m in us-west1-a

deploy-bot: shrinkwrap v2 rollout to 20% started at 2025-11-03T11:07:03Z :package:

michael: yup, I'm seeing long PodSchedule durations in traces — up to ~8s per pod, and some PDBs are getting torn (failed to evict only 1/3 replicas)

leo: can you paste k8s events/eviction logs? trying to see reason strings

anya: quick snippet:```bash
$ kubectl get events -n ml-jobs --sort-by=.lastTimestamp | tail -n 8
2025-11-03T11:11:02Z Warning  Evicted     pod/worker-3   The node was low on resource: ephemeral-storage.  
2025-11-03T11:11:03Z Warning  Evicted     pod/worker-2   NodeAffinityMismatch: node(s) didn't match node affinity
2025-11-03T11:11:04Z Normal   Killing     pod/worker-1   Pod preempted by shrinkwrap rescheduler
```

peggy: interesting — two different reasons. shrinkwrap might be aggressively consolidating and triggering both affinity mismatches and explicit preemptions. seeing job restarts + incomplete gangs

michael: main problem: shrinkwrap currently ignores PDBs when it does cross-node compaction. that causes single-replica windows where services lose quorum. also some descheduler logic is running concurrently and they fight each other

leo: suggestion: pause the rollout and revert to v1 until we add a PDB-safe mode. also add a per-az concurrency cap; most churn is in us-west1-a which is at 92% GPU utilization

anya: +1 to pause. can ops roll back? we have user-facing latency spikes on batch inference endpoints

ops-bot: rollback request acknowledged. Initiating shrinkwrap rollback to v1 for rollout-group: platform-gpu-20pct at 2025-11-03T11:15:40Z

peggy: long term fixes: 1) teach shrinkwrap to respect PodDisruptionBudget and gang-aware scheduling 2) add a soft-taint mode so we don't force-evict jobs that are close to completion 3) expose a small drain-window to the autoscaler so it can pre-warm replacement capacity

michael: also add exponential backoff for reschedules and a maxReschedules config per-job (default 3). I have a prototype PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/shrinkwrap/pull/492 (WIP)

leo: can we emit metrics: shrinkwrap_eviction_count, shrinkwrap_reschedule_latency_ms, shrinkwrap_conflict_pdb_count? alert when eviction_count > 50 in 5m per-az

peggy: I'll author the metrics PR and unit tests, then wire alerts. tagging infra oncall for follow-up

deploy-bot: rollback completed for shrinkwrap v2 -> v1 at 2025-11-03T11:18:12Z :white_check_mark:

anya: rollback confirmed, latency dropping back to baseline, jobs stop rescheduling

michael: follow-up tasks: PR to respect PDBs + backoff, metrics + alerts, a canary that limits per-az churn. I'll own the backoff + PR review

leo: I'll add the per-az cap and a feature-flagged soft-taint flow so we can test in staging

peggy: filing tickets and linking PRs in the postmortem. thanks everyone for the quick responses :thumbsup:

ops-bot: incident-ticket created: INC-2025-7412 "shrinkwrap rollout caused reschedule spike in us-west1-a"
